records.title: COMPASS: Enhancing Agent Long-Horizon Reasoning with Evolving Context
records.reason: 一次本文を確認したが、既存系統との関連またはLLM推論効率への効果が弱い/間接的で、追加の具体的検証が必要なためborderlineに残す。 COMPASS uses a main agent, meta-thinker and context manager to maintain concise task-stage briefs for long-horizon tool use; it reports accuracy gains and delegates context maintenance to smaller models for efficiency. The plausible follow-up is to quantify actual tokens, API cost, latency and quality against context-compression/routing baselines; the current evidence is agent-task-specific.
